NVT Name: GNU Bash Environment Variable Handling RCE Vulnerability (Shellshock, HTTP, CVE-2014-6271/CVE-2014-6278) - Active Check
Summary:
GNU Bash is prone to a remote command execution (RCE)
  vulnerability dubbed 'Shellshock'.
Specific Result:
By doing the following HTTP request:

Affected URL             : http://fedora:8080/victim.cgi
HTTP "User-Agent" header : () { OpenVASVT:; }; echo Content-Type: text/plain; echo; echo; PATH=/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin:/bin; export PATH; id;
HTTP Method              : GET

it was possible to execute the command "id".

Result:

uid=33(www-data) gid=33
Impact:
Successful exploitation will allow remote or local attackers to
  inject shell commands, allowing local privilege escalation or remote command execution depending
  on the application vector.
Solution: Update to patch version bash43-025 of Bash 4.3 or later.
Vulnerability Insight:
GNU bash contains a flaw that is triggered when evaluating
  environment variables passed from another environment. After processing a function definition,
  bash continues to process trailing strings.
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Sends multiple crafted HTTP GET and POST requests and checks
  the response.
